fields.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Quinn's''' ''{{ai|Blinding Assault|Quinn}}'' against the primary target, ''{{ai|Vault|Quinn}}'', and ''{{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}}'' mark enemies hit with ''Harrier'' for 4 seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}. '''{{ci|Valor}}''' will periodically mark a nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy if no ''Harrier'' targets exist for 1 second.
fields.description2: '''Quinn's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} against ''Harrier'' targets are empowered to consume the mark to deal {{pp|15 + (120-15)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=physical damage}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
fields.description4: While ''{{ai|Behind Enemy Lines|Quinn}}'' is active, ''Harrier'' is disabled and all ''Harrier'' marks are removed.
fields.notes:
* If a mark applied by an ability is overwritten, consumed, or timed out, ''Harrier'' goes on a 1-second cooldown if it's not already on cooldown.
* ''Harrier's'' targeting priority:
*# Last unit hit (if it was a small minion it appears to select a different target).
*# Lowest-health enemy champion.
*# Lowest-health enemy minion.
* ''Harrier'' is consumed even if it is parried, the attack is negated in any case.
* ''Harrier'' will not mark enemy {{tip|minions}} while '''Quinn''' is not {{tip|sight|visible}}, but will mark enemy {{tip|champions}}.
}}
